method: weeks[E] = [tvl_usd at height(E) (reserves from dex-data/state-history × that day’s price), vol_usd (Σ swap offer amounts in [height(E), height(E+1)) from the archive node × the week’s average price), swaps, complete (1 = every page read), unpriced (1 = a token had no price — that side is undercounted), reserve_implied (1 = one token priced from the pool’s own reserves against the other), traders (distinct tx signers that swapped on the pool that week), top1_pct / top3_pct (share of the week’s volume from the largest 1 / 3 traders), twoway_pct (share of the volume from traders who swapped both directions that week: Σ 2 × min(bought, sold) ÷ total)]. Pool aggregates only — no trader address is stored.
